# STOCKMATE (OMNISTOCK) FULL SYSTEM CONTEXT SPECIFICATION

## System Architecture Overview
StockMate (OmniStock) is an offline-first, multi-branch Point-of-Sale (POS) and Inventory Management System built with React 18, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS, and IndexedDB / SQLite persistence engines.

### Tech Stack
- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Lucide Icons, Recharts
- Storage & Sync: Dexie.js (IndexedDB), LocalStorage, ServiceWorker PWA cache
- Integrations: Thermal Printer ESC/POS driver, USB/Camera Barcode Scanner, Stripe Terminal

### Data Models
1. `products` (id, sku, barcode, name, category, price, cost, stock_quantity, min_stock_threshold)
2. `transactions` (id, receipt_number, timestamp, items, total_amount, payment_method, cashier_id)
3. `suppliers` (id, name, contact_email, lead_time_days, active_orders)
